newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra to sell property for FIM 204 mln.
newsitem.headline: Metra to sell property for FIM 204 mln.

text.p: Finnish diversified engineering group Metra Oy said in a statement on Monday it would sell its Hotel Strand Inter-Continental building for 204 million markka to a company of which it will own 19 percent.
"The deal will have a positive impact on Metra's shareholders' equity even after the revaulations allocated to this real-estate are written off," it said.

The buyer -- a real estate company to be establised and owned by state alcohol monopoly Alko Oy (41 percent), national carrier Finnair (40 percent) and Metra (19 percent) -- would also take over Finnair's Hotel Inter-Continental property, it said.
The agreements still require approval from the decision-making bodies of the three parties, Metra said.
"It is planned that the final agreements will come into force at the end of the year," it said.
The new company would have a share capital of 400 million markka and Metra said it would invest 76 million.
"The real estate company will lease both hotel properties to Nordic-Hotel Oy, a hotel and restaurant management company," it added.
